propositions: rebar search returns complete ticket bodies and comments for every match, causing excessive output size and context exhaustion in discovery operations
no output format flag exists; rebar search --output json is rejected as an unknown option rather than controlling output shape
search result schema lacks canonical definition, making inconsistency between CLI JSON, library default, and MCP outputs

default search output must project to bounded discovery fields (ticket_id, alias, title, ticket_type, status, priority, summary, snippet) with summary truncated to 240 characters and snippet extracted from first matching term position
rebar search --full must preserve legacy full TicketState JSON for migration; --full --output=llm must be rejected as incompatible
MCP search must advertise search_result.schema.json with summary-only fields while MCP show returns full bodies
